content.short: Novaseers is a project that aims to create a gamified metaverse, the Novaverse, where users can become part of the ecosystem and thrive with it.
content.description:
We introduce you to Novaseers, a gamified metaverse experience in Cardano, powered by Unity. In the Novaverse, all players receive the name of Xers. In your hands falls the responsibility of discovery and development of the Novas. The Novas are 3D modeled galaxies and the center of the action in this virtual universe.

You, a Xer, will need to explore, gather resources, enhance your equipment, and trade with other members of the Intergalactic community. It will be challenging, immersive, fun, and we'll be there all the time, helping you create a great civilization from the ground up.
